limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The elementary state-counting lemma, countable weighted-sum argument, Christensen--Pedersen countable result, and Berberian addability are prior art or standard ingredients. The claimed contribution is the exact identification kappa=max(aleph_0,s(M)), the resulting maximal/downward homogeneity spectrum under the simultaneous transfinite hypotheses, and the canonical-cardinal consequence for Arulseelan's local faithful-corner construction. Arbitrary AW*-algebras are not classified, and the normal-state analogue is not asserted. Older AW*/Baer-* dimension literature, especially Berberian 1972, was not exhaustively checked for an equivalent invariant in different terminology.
